CorpusEntry.description:
One document of the benchmark corpus, pinned to an exact version.

The PDF itself is never committed (redistribution rights). `make corpus` downloads `auto`
entries from `url`, checks every file present against `sha256`, and prints `instructions`
for each `manual` entry whose file is missing. A `manual` entry may leave `sha256` empty
until someone has downloaded and inspected the file; `pages` and `properties` stay unset
until then too.

id.description: Stable kebab-case slug; golden sets and results reference it.
id.title: Id

instructions.description: One line on what to download there. `manual` only.
instructions.title: Instructions

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the main language, e.g. `en`.
language.title: Language

notes.description: Anything a benchmark reader should know.
notes.title: Notes

pages.description: Set once the file is pinned.
pages.title: Pages

properties.description: Set once the file is pinned and inspected.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the PDF bytes. Empty: not pinned yet (`manual`).
sha256.title: Sha256

source_page.description: Page a person downloads the file from. `manual` only.
source_page.title: Source Page

url.description: Direct download URL of the pinned version. `auto` only.
url.title: Url

CorpusEntry.title: CorpusEntry

DocumentProperties.description:
Layout features that make a PDF hard to parse. Each flag is true when present.

Filled by hand in the manifest after inspecting the PDF, and detected by the Profiler at
run time, so the two can be compared.

formulas.description: Has mathematical notation beyond inline numbers.
formulas.title: Formulas

images.description: Has charts, figures or photos with information in them.
images.title: Images

multi_column.description: Body text is laid out in two or more columns.
multi_column.title: Multi Column

scanned.description: Pages are scanned images; any text layer comes from OCR, not the source.
scanned.title: Scanned

tables.description: Has data tables whose structure carries meaning.
tables.title: Tables

DocumentProperties.title: DocumentProperties
